shortDescription: V2 (banded single map) is working end-to-end: cross-band hauling, transit, see-below rendering with lighting/shadows/pawns, mountain generation, MORTON stairs, and a cross-level combat bridge. V1 (multi-map, ~130 patches) still shipped but superseded and ready to delete.
body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: sky above, surface, basement below. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky, (2) performance, (3) **full vanilla parity — the column is ONE BIG MAP**.

---

# ARCHITECTURE V2 — branch `v2-spike`, working end-to-end

## The model
ONE `Map`, size `(w, 1, bandCount × Slot)`. Bands stack along **+z** so each occupies a contiguous `CellIndices` range. `band = surfaceBand + level`; bottom-to-top reads basement / surface / sky. An impassable, permanently-fogged **gutter** separates bands.

**`Slot` is rounded up to a multiple of 64** (250-high band → slot 256, gutter 6). Not cosmetic: RimWorld terrain shaders sample from WORLD POSITION, so a non-aligned vertical offset makes the same terrain render with a different texture phase in the see-below view.

| Mechanism | How |
|---|---|
| Connectivity | Two `RegionType.Portal` regions sharing one synthetic `RegionLink`. `Region.Neighbors` is topological, not spatial ⇒ `Reachability.CanReach` works unpatched, which transitively fixes `ClosestThingReachable`, `RegionTraverser`, storage search and every `WorkGiver_Scanner` |
| Rooms/temperature | `Portal` fails `ShouldBeInTheSameRoom` ⇒ connectivity conducts, rooms stay separate |
| Movement | `Pawn_PathFollower.StartPath` prefix segments cross-band trips; a **per-tick position sweep** completes them |
| Reservations | Single `reservationManager` ⇒ double-claims impossible |

**PROVEN:** a colonist hauled steel out of a SEALED chamber joined only by a synthetic `RegionLink`, with zero hauling code. Cross-band transit verified end-to-end (`transit=YES` → `TRANSITED`).

### Hard 1.6 constraint
The pathfinder is **jobified** (`PathFinderJob` over `NativeArray`). A* neighbour expansion is NOT patchable — all custom traversal lives at `Pawn_PathFollower`. `PathRequest.ValidateInt` gates on `pawn.CanReach`, so reachability and path production must widen together.

## Files (`Source/V2/`)
`ABBandMap` (persisted layout, slot alignment) · `ABBands` (facade) · **`ABWormhole`** (synthetic RegionLink + re-arm postfix + `DebugDump`) · `ABWormholePather` (segmentation + tick sweep) · `ABBandedGeneration` (size inflation + carve) · `ABSkyBandGen` (mountain) · `SectionLayer_ABBelowV2` (see-below terrain/things) · `SectionLayer_ABBelowLighting` · `SectionLayer_ABBelowShadows` · `ABBelowDynamicDraw` (below pawns) · `Building_ABStairs2` · `ABStairsOrders` (float menu) · `ABBandView` (camera) · `ABBandEnv` · `ABBandInput` · **`ABCombatV2`** · `ABV2Debug` (bisect switches) · `ABV2DefCleanup`.

## Renderer (complete)
- **Terrain**: faithful port of vanilla's per-cell terrain print INCLUDING edge fades, snow/sand, pollution, Underwall. No uvs (world-position sampling).
- **Lighting**: ONE overlay with the glow SOURCE substituted per cell (see-through cells resolve glow/roof/edifice from the band below). Vanilla's overlay is suppressed on banded maps. Two complementary bakes caused vignetting because vertices are shared between cells — single-bake substitution fixed it.
- **Shadows**: `staticSunShadowHeight` re-emitted per cell (three skirts — west/east/south, each with its OWN winding; vanilla emits no north skirt). `shadowData` shadows come free via `t.Print`. Masked on "this cell or a neighbour is see-through" so cave walls don't hatch the cap.
- **Pawns below**: `Thing.DrawNowAt(loc)` with a band offset — no DrawPos patching at all.
- **Air mask + fog**: opaque backdrop (`SolidColorBehind`) so an open-air cell is never empty; vanilla `FogOfWar` over unexplored ground.
- **No dimming/shrink**: below content draws at full brightness and size (V1's dim was a substitute for real below-lighting).

## Combat bridge (`ABCombatV2`, ~200 lines vs V1's ~3,700)
Combat is the ONE system that doesn't come free: hauling/needs/work are GRAPH problems the wormhole solves, but LOS and range are computed in flat 2D cell space, and bands fake vertical adjacency with 256 cells of distance.
- `Verb.TryFindShootLineFromTo` prefix: adjacent bands only, range measured with the target translated into the shooter's band (+1 for the hop), horizontal drift capped at 12, LOS through an open-air "hole" checked within the upper band.
- `Projectile.Launch` prefix: origin translated into the target's band (V1 needed a whole file to move projectiles between Maps).
- `Pawn_RotationTracker.FaceTarget` prefix: face the TRANSLATED target, else the pawn snaps due north/south ("shoots straight down").
- **NOT DONE:** turrets, auto-engage (`AttackTargetFinder` still range-checks in cell space), click-targeting across bands.

## Bugs found in testing (the instructive ones)
1. **`dontRender` terrain silently suppresses shadows** — `SectionLayer_Terrain` swaps in `MatBases.ShadowMask`, the void mask. `AB_OpenAir` is dontRender, so every see-through cell was a shadow dead zone. Found only by disabling all our own layers and seeing shadows STILL absent. Saved to lore.
2. **Terrain shaders use world-position UVs** — `Printer_Plane` writes 0..1 uvs and produced a muddy smear. Build terrain quads by hand. Saved to lore.
3. **Transit completion must not depend on `PatherArrived`** — the pather ends legs in many places (re-issued path, interrupting job, stopping short). Three fixes failed on that assumption before switching to a per-tick position sweep.
4. **Never `Clear` a transit record on same-band `StartPath`** — segmentation rewrites the destination INTO the pawn's own band, so that branch sees its own leg. Records expire on a 4000-tick timeout instead.
5. Vanilla emits **three** sun-shadow skirts with **different windings** — a generic helper produced jagged sawtooth.
6. `menuHidden` doesn't exist on ThingDef (use `<designationCategory />`); geysers are `destroyable=false` (DeSpawn, don't Destroy); `GenStep_Fog` fogs the whole map so the sky band must be explicitly unfogged; `GenRadial` caps at ~79.8.

## Diagnostics (keep these)
`AB2: band info` (layout + full wormhole state incl. `CanReach`) · `AB2: below layer report` (per-submesh verts/queue/material) · `AB2: lighting report` · `AB2: toggle transit logging` · `AB2: bisect - toggle below terrain/things/air mask/lighting`. **Lesson: measuring beat reasoning every single time.** Emit one self-contained message per event — separate log calls share a stack signature and get folded by the monitor.

## LOCKED DECISIONS
1. Save break accepted. 2. Banding lazy-reveal (bands exist at gen, opened by stairs). 3. One map, three layers. 4. Stairs are `Building_Door` subclasses. 5. Perf ceiling accepted; About must warn about large maps.

## REMAINING WORK
1. **Click-through-open-air for orders** — V1's `ABBelowGotoDrag`/`BelowSelection`. You can SEE the level below but clicks resolve to the sky cell. This is what makes drafted commands feel seamless.
2. **Combat acquisition** — turrets, auto-engage, cross-band targeting UI.
3. **Delete V1** (~110 patches, `ABVirtualPosition`, probe/damper layer) — gated on combat parity.
4. **Measure the pathfinding cost** — `PathGridJob` is `IJobParallelFor` over ALL cells, so ~3× vs V1 where only maps with pathing pawns pay. The one place V2 is genuinely worse; still unmeasured.
5. Transplant (coastline fidelity, save migration, true-lazy) · per-band biome consumers (wild animals, ambient sound, disease MTB) · sky richness (outcrops, hidden valleys).

---

# V1 (SHIPPED, superseded)
Workshop `3767572810`. ~130 Harmony patches, 165 files / ~42.5k LOC, levels as pocket maps. Frozen on `master`. Its cross-level machinery goes inert on a banded map by itself (keys off `upperMap`/`lowerMap`, which stay null); `ABV2DefCleanup` strips its 9 vertical-link buildings from the architect menu.

## TESTING RULE
isolated=true always. Companion **`astryl.ModernDevTools`**; NOT Melee Animation. Palette pins get culled for Playing-gated debug actions — use the Debug Actions menu. **V2 banding happens at generation ⇒ needs a NEW colony** (quicktest qualifies). Map gen is ~3× slower — expected. **Use inland tiles until transplant lands** (map-edge features like coastlines can land in a carved band).

## Status
V2 working end-to-end: banded generation, wormhole connectivity, cross-band transit, full see-below renderer (terrain/lighting/shadows/pawns), mountain sky, MORTON stairs + ladders, combat bridge core. Next: click-through orders, combat acquisition, then V1 deletion.
